preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x_i <= N and 0 <= y_i <= N for x_i, y_i in edges)

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not valid_sequence else ' '.join(map(str, A))
postconditions.description: If no valid sequence exists, output -1; otherwise, output the lexicographically smallest sequence A.

postconditions.expression: all(f(subseq) == y_i for subseq, y_i in zip(subsequences, [y_i for _, y_i in edges]))
postconditions.description: The function f applied to each subsequence must match the destination vertex of each edge.

postconditions.expression: len(A) == N and all(isinstance(a, int) and a > 0 for a in A)
postconditions.description: The output sequence A must have length N and consist of positive integers.
